races.paceDynamic: Bownder emerges as the sole confirmed front-runner with Showmedemoney and Alazwar likely to press from prominent positions early. The pace should be honest but not punishing given the limited early speed, allowing Bownder to dictate terms through steady fractions over this 1m2f trip. The bulk of the field comprises hold-up horses who will need the race to develop into a sprint finish, but with such a soft early pace likely, the prominent runners and any horse that can secure an early position will hold a significant tactical advantage. This race shape clearly favours horses that can race prominently or get a good early position rather than those relying on late kicks.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Bownder establishes an uncontested lead with honest but manageable fractions
scenarios.body: The pace-setter can dictate throughout and prove hard to peg back up the Windsor straight. With most rivals held up and needing the race to come to them, those racing on or near the speed gain a crucial positional edge.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Battle Develops
scenarios.trigger: If Showmedemoney and Alazwar press Bownder from the start creating genuine pace
scenarios.body: The increased tempo plays into the hands of horses with proven finishing kicks from mid-division. Strong stayers who can close from off the pace will benefit from the stronger gallop.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Closing Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace collapses completely with all front runners going too slowly
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure sprint from the home turn favouring horses with the best turn of foot. Class horses with proven acceleration despite moderate recent form can capitalise.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Bownder fails to lead or the prominent horses all get slowly away
scenarios.body: An unfancied hold-up horse can steal through on the rails or get first run in the straight. Horses carrying light weights with apprentice allowances gain maximum benefit from the weak early pace.
